atp.definition: integral over calibrated emission-time window of (mean_m s_m(u+distance_m/c))^2 du; optional axial plane-wave excitation time
atp.reference: Davies et al. (2021), DOI 10.1109/TUFFC.2020.3026165; source-emitter/plane-wave variants

cf.definition: max_u [CF(u)^p mean_m y_m(u)]^2; CF=|sum y|^2/(M sum |y|^2)

tea.definition: integral_gate (mean_m s_m(u + distance_m/c))^2 du; no self-energy subtraction

definitions.axial_fwhm_m: Half-power width through global peak, interpolated; single source only, unavailable for boundary-truncated lobes.
definitions.background_peak_db: 10 log10(max map outside truth disks / global peak). Lower is better. This is an exclusion-region background measure, not a PSF sidelobe level.
definitions.cnr: abs(mean target - mean background) / sqrt(population variance target + population variance background). Descriptive; dynamic-range sensitive.
definitions.contrast_db: 10 log10(mean linear target / mean linear background); pixel means, signed contrast. Higher favours bright targets.
definitions.gcnr: 1 - sum(min(target PMF, background PMF)); shared uniform histogram bins on linear map/global peak in [0,1]. Descriptive region separation [0,1], not a clinical detection probability. Finite bins/sample counts can bias this estimator.
definitions.half_power_area_m2: Trapezoidal area of the 4-connected >=half-global-peak component containing the peak; boundary contact is flagged. Smaller alone does not establish correct localization.
definitions.lateral_fwhm_m: Half-power width through global peak, interpolated; single source only, unavailable for boundary-truncated lobes.
definitions.localization_error_m: Global map peak to nearest configured source; not per-source detection recall. Lower is better.
definitions.normalized_entropy: -sum(p log p)/log(number of pixels), p=linear map/sum(map). Lower is more concentrated, which can also indicate a misplaced artefact.
definitions.roi_concentration: Integral of linear map inside the union of truth disks / integral over the ROI grid, using trapezoidal spatial weights. Map concentration, not physical acoustic energy. Higher is better for this target definition.

atp.metric_note: Global peak to nearest truth; multi-source FWHM disabled. Broad/boundary-truncated lobes have no FWHM.
warnings: Fewer regional pixels than histogram bins; gCNR is sensitive to undersampling. Inspect bin/radius sensitivity.

notes: Descriptive synthetic-truth evaluation; no universal composite score or clinical validity.
Regional scores use linear maps and a common truth radius. Display dB/colour settings do not affect them.
Runtime is shared; storage bytes are not peak RAM. Histogram estimates depend on bins and grid resolution.
runtime_scope: shared selected-method reconstruction wall time; not individual method timing
